dialogues.speaker: Lyubertsi
dialogues.text: I'm a rank-and-file Ratnik in charge of menial tasks and admin work. You can also say I'm the one who handles visitors around here.

dialogues.speaker: Lyubertsi
dialogues.text: Please let me know if there's any danger you'd like us Lightkeepers to handle for you. I'll arrange for someone to take care of it.
